description: The system shall store the playlogs of the players.
Each playlog must have a date, client, and player assigned.
The system shall store the connections of the players.
Each connection must have a date, client, and player assigned.
The connection status can only be connected or not connected.
The system shall store the actions performed on the platform.
Each action must have a date, client, user, and player assigned.
All actions must be performed on an entity of the platform.
The system shall allow authorized users to list the playlogs.
The playlogs visible to the user shall depend on their assigned permissions.
The user must be able to view all details of the playlog.
The system shall allow authorized users to list the connections of the players.
The connections visible to the user shall depend on their assigned permissions.
Connections shall only have two states: connected or not connected.
The system shall allow authorized users to list the actions performed on the platform entities.
The actions visible to the user shall depend on their assigned permissions.
All actions must be related to an entity of the platform.
The system shall respond quickly when the user performs an action.
The system shall respond to any user action in less than 5 seconds.
The system shall be available at all times, except for scheduled updates.
Any user must be able to access the platform at any time of the day, except during scheduled updates.
The system shall be capable of supporting an unlimited number of concurrent connections.
The platform shall scale dynamically with changes in simultaneous connections.
The system shall be able to grow in capacity when the volume of data increases.
The system shall scale automatically as data increases.
System functionalities shall only be accessible to users with the corresponding permissions.
Users without permission shall not be able to access data for which they do not have authorization.
Confidential user information must be protected to ensure privacy.
Users shall only be able to observe confidential data belonging to their own user account.
